newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Ports of Auck sees growth in trade volume.
newsitem.headline: Ports of Auck sees growth in trade volume.

text.p: Ports of Auckland Ltd expects continuing long term growth in trade volumes, particularly in container traffic, despite a recent slowing in economic activity, Chairman Sir Richard Carter said in the annual report.
Carter said indicators suggest continuing steady growth in the New Zealand domestic economy.
But he said there was some expectation that growth would level off in the short term and that pre-election uncertainty had slowed economic activity.
Ports of Auckland handled a record 10.1 million tonnes of cargo in the year to June, up from 9.6 million a year earlier. Of the total, 6.5 million tonnes were handled in containers.
